items.prompt: What does this successful same-directory os.replace primarily supply?

options.why: It does not prove durable contents or model validity.

options.text: An atomic compare-and-swap that prevents concurrent writers replacing each other
options.why: Atomic replacement is not a conditional multi-writer compare-and-swap; this demo assumes a single trusted writer.

items.explanation: Atomicity, visibility and durability have distinct scopes.
